company.name: MixR
company.shortDescription: B2B community building platform on a mission to address lack of belonging at work and create healthier, happier & more productive workforces
company.description:
MixR is a California-based HR Tech startup. We help enterprises build exceptional company cultures, and keep people connected, fulfilled and productive along the way. Our B2B, SaaS platform empowers employees to create vibrant communities around their interests and organize in-person community events - driving belonging and wellbeing at scale.

Employee loneliness, burnout, turnover and disengagement are at all time highs, and they’re costing U.S. organizations upwards of $2.5 trillion per year. The time is NOW to invest in a healthier workforce to drive sustainable productivity and long-term business results. 

MixR is leading the next generation of employee wellbeing tools by focusing on the human aspects of work: Trust, Belonging, Diversity & Inclusion. 

To date, we’ve raised $5M in pre-series A funding from investors across the U.S. and Europe. To learn more, visit www.mixr.net. For fundraising inquiries, contact [email omitted].
